text: dsh-codex-oauth 是一个适用于 DSH Web 与 TUI 的 OpenAI Codex 模型接入插件。它将 Codex OAuth 凭据交给 DSH 的 LLM 适配器，通过 Responses API 流式调用 ChatGPT 计划模型，并提供浏览器登录、账户选择、动态模型目录、Web 设置面板和配额状态展示。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 ChatGPT 计划所含 Codex 模型的用户。需要可授权计划用量的 ChatGPT 账户，不需要 API Key。

dsh-codex-oauth connects Codex models to DSH Web and TUI. It registers a DSH LLM adapter for streaming Responses API calls, with ChatGPT sign-in, account selection, a live model catalog, Web settings, and quota displays. A ChatGPT account with plan authorization is required; no API key is needed.
想用 ChatGPT 计划里的 Codex 模型来回答 DSH 对话。
怎么用浏览器登录后让 DSH 调用 Codex？
让 DSH 自动列出我账号当前能用的 OpenAI 模型。
在 Web 设置里管理 ChatGPT 登录和切换账户。
想查看 Codex 计划还剩多少配额、什么时候重置。
Use my ChatGPT plan's Codex models in DSH conversations.
Can I sign in with ChatGPT and see the models available to my account?
dsh-codex-oauth 的功能「Codex 模型接入」：通过 DSH LLM 适配器调用 Responses API，并流式返回结果。
dsh-codex-oauth 的功能「浏览器授权和账户管理」：通过本地回调完成 ChatGPT OAuth，可在 Web 设置面板进行登录、登出和账户选择；授权信息由插件凭据存储管理。
dsh-codex-oauth 的功能「模型目录与用量查看」：按需列出账号可用模型，并在 TUI 状态行及 /codex-usage 命令显示可用的 Codex 配额窗口与重置时间。
Show my remaining Codex usage and reset windows in the terminal.

dsh-codex-oauth README · dsh-codex-oauth：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

Use ChatGPT plan models in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) through [OpenAI's direct OAuth integration](https://developers.openai.com/siwc/token-sharing-open-source). Version 0.3 implements DSH's official `LlmAdapter` directly and has no `pi-ai` or `dsh-llm-pi-ai` dependency.

dsh-codex-oauth README · dsh-codex-oauth：The plugin handles browser authorization, account selection, rotating token refresh, current account model discovery, and Responses streaming. It translates DSH tools, images and conversation history, and preserves completed encrypted reasoning for subsequent turns. Filesystem access, tool execution, permissions and context compaction remain DSH responsibilities.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Requirements and installation：Requires Node.js 22 or newer and DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` compatible `dsh-llm` and `dsh-atomic-write` packages. Version 0.3 no longer supports the old DSH 0.1 adapter contract.

Install into the profile you actually run:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add -w dsh-codex-oauth@^0.3.0
dsh --profile dsh-tui
```

For a source checkout:

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm pack --ignore-scripts
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add -w "file:$PWD/dsh-codex-oauth-0.3.0.tgz"

dsh-codex-oauth README · Requirements and installation：For the Web surface, use `--profile web` and launch `dsh web`.

Installing the archive also avoids pnpm reusing an older local directory's file list when upgrading an existing source installation.

If the TUI profile also loads its built-in subscription OAuth module, exclude `openai-codex` from `dsh-tui-auth` so this plugin owns that provider. In `$DSH_HOME/profiles/dsh-tui/cordis.patch.yml` (default `~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-tui/cordis.patch.yml`):

dsh-codex-oauth README · Requirements and installation：```yaml
- id: dsh-tui-auth
  config:
    providers: [anthropic, xai, meta]
```

Preserve any existing `credentialsFile` and `modelOverrides` in that block. Retain only providers supported by your installed TUI. Restart the profile after upgrading the plugin.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Sign in and choose a model：```bash
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui exec dsh-openai-codex login
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui exec dsh-openai-codex status
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui exec dsh-openai-codex models --refresh
```

Authorize the application in the browser and allow ChatGPT plan usage. The local callback binds to `127.0.0.1:1455`, falling back to another loopback port when necessary. This flow requires browser authorization; `--device-code` is unavailable.
section: Sign in and choose a model

text: dsh-codex-oauth README · Sign in and choose a model：In the Web UI, open **Settings → OpenAI Codex**, select **Continue with ChatGPT**, and return after authorization. The section offers account selection, cancellation, sign-out, model refresh and a [manage usage link](https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage). Identity-only authorization is shown separately; sign in again to authorize plan usage.
section: Sign in and choose a model

text: dsh-codex-oauth README · Sign in and choose a model：Choose provider `openai-codex` in DSH's model picker. Models come from the selected account's live catalog, including new releases such as GPT-6.1 Sol when the account has access. The plugin preserves the server's display names and ordering, caches the catalog for five minutes, and supports explicit refresh. It does not maintain a fixed model list.

text:
dsh-codex-oauth README · Accounts and credentials：```bash
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui exec dsh-openai-codex login --new-account
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui exec dsh-openai-codex accounts
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui exec dsh-openai-codex use <client-id>
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui exec dsh-openai-codex logout

dsh-codex-oauth README · Accounts and credentials：Each account retains its issued application registration. Reauthorization reuses that registration and verifies the same identity. Sign-out attempts remote revocation, clears the selected account's local tokens and keeps the registration for later sign-in. It leaves other accounts intact. Cancelling a pending login preserves the previous account.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Accounts and credentials：Credentials are stored in `$DSH_HOME/.openai-codex-auth.v2.json`, defaulting to `~/.dsh/.openai-codex-auth.v2.json`. The versioned document keeps a stable host identifier, account registrations and the active selection. Writes are atomic; the directory is owner-only and the file is `0600` on POSIX. A cross-process lock serializes token rotation. Temporary refresh failures preserve credentials; terminal refresh failures clear expired authorization.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Accounts and credentials：**Upgrade from 0.2:** sign in again using the new authorization flow. Legacy `.openai-codex-auth.json` credentials cannot authorize this API route and are left untouched. The plugin never imports or changes `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` or `~/.codex/auth.json`.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Supported behavior and limits：Requests use `https://api.openai.com/v1/responses` with OAuth, `store: false`, `stream: true` and the required history in `input`. No API key is required. Usage is subject to ChatGPT plan eligibility and application quotas; the plugin never falls back to API key billing.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Supported behavior and limits：DSH's session identity supplies stable `session-id` and `x-client-request-id` headers for ordinary and compaction calls. This preserves the gateway's session affinity for prompt-cache reuse; cache hits are still not guaranteed. Calls without a session identity omit these headers.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Supported behavior and limits：- DSH function tools run locally, grouped in a Responses namespace. All offered definitions are sent; native Responses `tool_search` is unavailable on this route.
- Text and images use DSH attachments. Files and offloaded images are represented by local handles for DSH tools; this plugin does not upload files to OpenAI's Files API.
- Reasoning effort and context metadata come from the live catalog when advertised. Replay state is reused only for unchanged blocks from the same model and account. Compacted or edited messages use the remaining DSH history.
- `temperature`, `maxTokens` and `stop` fail with `UNSUPPORTED_OPTION` when set, because this ChatGPT plan route does not support them. Leave them unset in your agent configuration.
- DSH history summarization (`purpose: compaction`) accepts the `maxTokens` budget supplied automatically by its compaction backend and omits it from the API request. Automatic and manual DSH compaction can run, but the backend's summary output cap is not enforced by this route. The existing history prefix is preserved before the appended summarization instruction.
- Only a completed response is succ
dsh-codex-oauth README · Supported behavior and limits：See OpenAI's [current preview limitations](https://developers.openai.com/siwc/token-sharing-open-source/preview-limitations).

dsh-codex-oauth README · Quota display：Web settings show English remaining-quota bars and reset timestamps. The TUI status line shows a compact summary; `/codex-usage` expands all available windows and their last-update times. Windows are labeled by the server's duration (300 minutes is 5h, 10,080 minutes is Weekly), not their primary/secondary position.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Quota display：The compact summary is `codex 81% 4h36m 50% 5d4m`, with shorter windows first. `*` marks stale data; `?` means the reset time is unavailable. For dsh-tui 0.14.0, `node scripts/patch-tui-quota-placement.mjs [path/to/Chat.js]` moves just this contribution into the model/effort footer row below the input box and saves sibling backups of Chat.js and StatusLine.js. The existing field layout truncates narrow rows rather than adding a quota row. This is a local host patch because the public status API only supports placement above the prompt. Reinstalling/upgrading the TUI may remove it; the patch refuses unsupported versions.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Quota display：For an npm-installed TUI profile, apply the optional patch with:

```bash
node "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/dsh-tui/node_modules/dsh-codex-oauth/scripts/patch-tui-quota-placement.mjs"
```

Restart the TUI afterward. Without this patch the summary uses the standard position above the input box. Installation never applies the patch automatically.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Quota display：The adapter observes `x-codex-*` response headers and `codex.rate_limits` stream events from normal requests. When these do not provide fresh data, the display queries `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage` with the plugin's retained legacy Codex credentials in `.openai-codex-auth.json`, beside its native auth file. It does not read Pi or Codex app credentials, change the inference route, or call a model. Successful lookups are cached for 60 seconds; failures back off for 30 seconds. Concurrent displays share one request.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Quota display：This fallback reports Codex subscription limits, which have not been proven identical to the native SIWC application's limits. The saved credentials must have matching email claims; matching email does not establish the same workspace. This qualification belongs to the documentation, not the UI. Missing, expired, unrelated, or rejected legacy credentials leave quota unavailable. The lookup does not refresh or modify the legacy login: renew that login separately when it expires.

dsh-codex-oauth README · Quota display：Snapshots stay in memory, clear on account changes/sign-out, and become stale after five minutes or a reported reset. Failed queries preserve the previous snapshot; passing a reset timestamp never fabricates a fresh 100% allowance. Source formats are parsed independently rather than merging windows from different endpoints.

```bash
npm install
npm test

dsh-codex-oauth README · Optional: requires a signed-in test account; uses ChatGPT plan allowance.：DSH_HOME=/path/to/test-home npm run test:live -- gpt-6.1-sol
```

`npm test` builds the Web bundle and checks OAuth identity validation, concurrent refresh, account changes, Web route boundaries, streamed errors, tool and reasoning replay, attachments and integration with DSH's official runtime. The live check performs a three-turn tool round trip and verifies history replay.
